page.overview:
Who is Gasuka?

When a wild boar began to come to the gardens of the inhabitants of the country and spoil the harvest, Taizō gathered friends and offered to hunt him down. Gasuka remarked that this was dangerous, but when Taizō assured him that Asura will protect them with ninshū, he agreed. After some time, they managed to reach the boar, which pursued Asura and killed Shiro who was protecting him. Gasuka and the others hid in a tree while Asura was rescued by his brother Indra.

Many years later, as adults, Gasuka and Edashi came to Taizō, who was hiding in a hut on a hill, and informed him that Hagoromo sent Asura on a mission to another village. When Asura was appointed as Hagoromo's successor, Gasuka attended the party, after helping to fight Indra, who was unhappy with his father's choice.

Gasuka was a little cowardly as a child, as he did not really want to go on a dangerous adventure in chasing a boar. However, he went after his friends without leaving them. As an adult, Gasuka showed concern for Asura, informing Taizō of his departure from the village.

Gasuka is a guy of medium height with long brown hair and black eyes. He wears a grey kimono tied with a belt, a lilac t-shirt, and pants. His ankles owe him bandages, and Gasuka didn't wear any sandals or boots.
